sn35.244:1.1: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaṃ yeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn35.244:1.2: atha kho panassa kāmā diṭṭhā honti yathāssa kāme passato yo kāmesu kāmachando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti
sn35.244:1.3: tathā kho panassa cāro ca vihāro ca anubandho hoti. yathā carantaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānussavanti.
sn35.244:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaṃ yeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn35.244:2.2: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo.
sn35.244:2.6: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
sn35.244:2.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaṃ yeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn35.244:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmā diṭṭhā honti yathāssa kāme passato yo kāmesu kāmachando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti.
sn35.244:3.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā puṇṇā aṅgārānaṃ vītacchikānaṃ vitadumānaṃ. atha kho puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo tamenaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānā bāhāsu gahetvā taṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ so iti imameva kāyaṃ sannāmeyya.
sn35.244:3.4: aññāṇañhi bhikkhave tassa purisassa hoti imañcāhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ ca passāmi tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā gacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
sn35.244:3.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā diṭṭhā honti yathāssa kāme passato yo kāmesu kāmachando kāmasneso kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti.
sn35.244:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno cāro ca vihāro ca anubandho hoti yathā carantaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānussavanti.
sn35.244:4.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso bahukaṇṭakaṃ dāyaṃ paviseyya tassa puratopi kaṇṭako pacchatopi kaṇṭako uttaratopi kaṇṭako dakkhiṇatopi kaṇṭako heṭṭhatopi kaṇṭako uparitopi kaṇṭako so satova abhikkameyya satova paṭikkameyya mā maṃ kaṇṭakoti.
sn35.244:4.3: evameva kho bhikkhave yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ ayaṃ vuccati ariyassa vinaye kaṇṭakoti.
sn35.244:4.4: iti viditvā asaṃvaro ca saṃvaro ca veditabbo.
sn35.244:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso
sn35.244:5.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti …pe…
sn35.244:5.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati appiyarūpe dhamme byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso
sn35.244:5.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.244:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso
sn35.244:6.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti …pe…
sn35.244:6.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati appiyarūpe dhamme na byāpajjati upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso
sn35.244:6.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.244:7.1: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ carato evaṃ viharato kadāci karahaci satisammosā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā. dandho bhikkhave satuppādo atha kho naṃ khippameva pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
sn35.244:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso divasaṃ santatte ayokaṭāhe dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni nipāteyya. dandho bhikkhave udakaphusitānaṃ nipāto atha kho naṃ khippameva parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.
sn35.244:8.2: evameva kho bhikkhave tassa ce bhikkhuno evaṃ carato evaṃ viharato kadāci karahaci satisammosā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā. dandho bhikkhave satuppādo atha kho naṃ khippameva pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
sn35.244:8.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno cāro ca vihāro ca anubandho hoti yathā carantaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānussavanti.
sn35.244:8.4: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ evaṃ carantaṃ evaṃ viharantaṃ rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ
sn35.244:8.5: ehambho purisa kinte ime kāsāvā anudayhanti.
sn35.244:8.7: ehi hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu puññāni ca karohīti.
sn35.244:8.8: so ca taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ caranto evaṃ viharanto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn35.244:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā atha mahājanakāyo āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya mayaṃ imaṃ gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ pacchāninnaṃ karissāma pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti.
sn35.244:9.3: api nu kho so mahājanakāyo gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ pacchāninnaṃ kareyya pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti.
sn35.244:9.6: gaṅgā bhante nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā
sn35.244:9.7: sā na sukarā pacchāninnā kātuṃ pacchāpoṇā pacchāpabbhārā.
sn35.244:9.8: yāvadeva pana so mahājanakāyo kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti.
sn35.244:9.9: evameva kho bhikkhave tañce bhikkhuṃ evaṃ carantaṃ evaṃ viharantaṃ rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ
sn35.244:9.10: ehambho purisa kiṃ te ime kāsāvā anudayhanti.
sn35.244:9.12: ehi hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu puññāni ca karohīti.
sn35.244:9.13: so vata bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ caranto evaṃ viharanto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn35.244:9.15: yaṃ hi taṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ vivekaninnaṃ vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ tañca hīnāyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
